question: Should `/workspace` remain a sandbox-only reserved path, or become a supported alias for the default workspace in gateway and CLI runtime containers?
rationale: Current code and docs deliberately use different runtime and sandbox paths, and either answer establishes a user-visible container contract with multi-agent and security implications.

options.title: Keep Sandbox-Only
options.body: Retain `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` for runtime containers and update any bootstrap or guidance that implies `/workspace` is universally available.

options.title: Support Runtime Alias
options.body: Add a consistent alias across Docker and Podman runtime paths with explicit default-workspace, multi-agent, sandbox-security, and upgrade documentation.

recommendation.title: Keep Sandbox-Only
recommendation.body: Retain `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` for runtime containers and update any bootstrap or guidance that implies `/workspace` is universally available.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is connected to the baseline container and sandbox path history and already framed the unresolved contract in the prior review.
